newsitem.title: JAPAN: New party launched as Japan gears up for election.
newsitem.headline: New party launched as Japan gears up for election.

text.p: Political defectors from Japan's established parties formally launched a new party on Saturday as the nation geared up for October 20 elections.
The Democratic Party of Japan (DPJ), a group of defectors from the junior coalition Social Democrats and Sakigake parties, pledged to grow into a new political force.
"We will try our best to change Japan's politics," said maverick health minister Naoto Kan, who was formally chosen together with former Sakigake Chief Secretary Yukio Hatoyama to head the new party.

Kan, who aims to make the Democrats a vehicle to attract urban voters disappointed with established parties, achieved hero status this year when he revealed health ministry complicity in a decades-old scandal in which HIV, the virus that causes AIDS, was spread in untreated blood products.
